instructions:
1. Sit on an exercise ball and walk your feet forward until the ball supports your lower back and hips.
2. Set your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart and place your hands behind your head.
3. Lean back over the ball to lengthen your abs into the start position.
4. Curl your upper body up by contracting your abs until your torso is near vertical.
5. Lower back over the ball with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement from your abs, not by pulling on your head.
2. Keep contact with the ball to protect your lower back.
3. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
4. Move slowly to avoid using momentum.

instructions:
1. Place an exercise ball between your lower back and a wall.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of your hips.
3. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, letting the ball roll up your back.
4. Stop when your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees stay over your toes.
5. Push through your heels to stand back up.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Set your feet far enough forward that your knees stay above your ankles.
2. Keep your back flat against the ball.
3. Inhale as you lower and exhale as you push up.
4. Drive through your heels, not your toes.

instructions:
1. Start in a push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and your body in a straight line.
2. Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
3. Press up explosively so your hands leave the floor or your body pushes up fast.
4. Land with soft elbows and absorb the impact.
5. Lower straight into the next rep.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through the whole hand to generate power.
2. Keep your core braced so your hips do not sag.
3. Exhale hard on the explosive push.
4. Use a non-slip surface for safe landings.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet about 120 cm apart, right foot turned out 90 degrees and left foot slightly turned in.
2. Bend your right knee until it sits over your right ankle and your thigh is parallel to the floor, keeping your left leg straight.
3. Lean to the right and rest your right forearm on your right thigh.
4. Reach your left arm overhead to make a straight line from left hand to left foot.
5. Hold, then return to standing with control.
6. Repeat on the other side.
tips:
1. Keep your bent knee stacked over your ankle.
2. Press your back foot into the floor to stay stable.
3. Lengthen along your top side rather than collapsing into the lower arm.
4. Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

instructions:
1. Stand or sit with your back straight and shoulders relaxed.
2. Rotate your head toward your left shoulder, then drop your chin diagonally toward that shoulder.
3. Hold and breathe deeply to feel the stretch along the side of your neck.
4. Return your head to the neutral position.
5. Repeat the stretch toward the right shoulder.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulders down and relaxed during the stretch.
2. Move into the stretch slowly and smoothly.
3. Only stretch to a comfortable range, never to pain.
4. Keep your back tall throughout.
